s.headline: Fortnitemares Horror Islands and Override Update Launch
top_changes: New spine-chilling Fortnitemares islands with Safety in Numbers Quest
Fortnite: Override introduces game-changing Overrides inspired by Sonic, Tetris, Pac-Man
Cursed cartridge corrupts Battle Royale with new weapons, mechanics, and bosses
Five Nights at Freddy's animatronic bosses at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor
New collectible Sprites with powers now appear in Ranked (abilities disabled)
s.meta_impact: The update adds horror-themed bosses and mechanics that force new survival strategies in Battle Royale. Override and Sprites introduce variable powers and exploration, shifting focus toward collection and adaptation. Ranked remains balanced by disabling Sprite abilities.

s.headline: VALORANT 13.08: Map Rating, Corrode Updates & Map Pool Swap
top_changes: Map Rating system added for Competitive/Premier
Corrode map changes to defender paths, mid, and plant
Map pool: Bind & Corrode in, Ascent & Split out
Performance Score adjustments for damage/kills/deaths
Vanguard ban numbers shared for Act 5
s.meta_impact: Map rotation forces adaptation to Bind and Corrode playstyles. Map Rating pushes players to specialize on maps for better grades. Performance Score tweaks better value utility and first bloods across agents.

s.headline: Matchmaking Test Increases Plat+ Queue Times
top_changes: Matchmaking test activated for Plat+ on all platforms
Max queue times increased scaling with rank tier
Masters players may see up to 30s extension
Prioritizes tighter skill band lobbies before expanding search
s.meta_impact: High-rank matches should see tighter skill bands with less spillover into mid-rank lobbies. Plat+ players face modestly longer queues in exchange for improved matchmaking quality. The test runs until season end or enough data is gathered.

breakdown.name: Matchmaking System
breakdown.change: Increases max queue times for Plat+ to tighten skill bands

s.headline: Marvel Rivals Halloween Patch: New Events & Bug Fixes
top_changes: Pop & Win spooky costume event launches
All Hallows' Glow event with free rewards
Jeff the Land Shark Reservoir Ripple bug fix
Black Widow Bite Bounce mobility fix
Map collision stability improvements
s.meta_impact: Patch adds seasonal events and cosmetics with no hero balance changes. Bug fixes improve Jeff and Black Widow reliability in specific modes. Overall meta stays the same as gameplay mechanics remain untouched.

breakdown.change: Fixed various collision issues that could trap heroes in environment

s.headline: Worlds patch: Ambessa/K'Sante nerfs, Rocketbelt changes
top_changes: Ambessa Passive damage reduced
K'Sante W mana cost up, damage reduction down
Hextech Rocketbelt AH reduced, active damage increased
Kennen E and Kindred W/E buffs
Multiple Classic mode champions added
buffs: Diana: W shield bonus health ratio 11% → 14%
Kindred: W monster mod 150% → 165%, E slow 1s → 1.5s
Mordekaiser: Q scaling +7/lvl, R CD reduced
Neeko: E base damage and root duration increased
Smolder: Passive crit scaling and R heal increased
nerfs: K'Sante: W mana cost increased, W DR 30/75% → 25/70%
Yunara: Q on-hit damage reduced, W slow no longer stacks
Experimental Hexplate: Ranged mod reduced to 50%
s.meta_impact: Nerfs to pro staples Ambessa and K'Sante plus Rocketbelt changes should reduce their dominance heading into Worlds. Buffs to Kennen, Kindred, and others aim to bring more variety into viability. Classic mode additions and Mayhem tweaks add side content without shifting Rift meta.
